_nota: Fuente: Números 22:21-35 (también 2 Pedro 2:16). El ángel se muestra como figura de luz sin rostro; nunca el rostro de Dios ni de Jesús. Rehecho en 2D el 30 oct (pedido del usuario): el personaje fijo hace de Balaam; el ángel es un resplandor de luz alado, sin figura humana.

bal-03-angel: a narrow dusty path between rocky hills with a huge blinding column of white light with the shape of wings in the middle of the road, golden rays

bal-05-muros: a narrow path between two low stone walls of vineyards on both sides, a gray donkey pressed against the wall, warm afternoon light
bal-06-suelo: a very narrow gap between two big rocks with a gray donkey lying down on the ground, dust in the air, dramatic light
bal-07-habla: close view of a gray donkey with big expressive eyes and open mouth as if speaking, desert background, soft magical glow
bal-08-ve: a blinding column of white light with the shape of wings on a desert road, rays filling the sky, a gray donkey bowing its head
